name: ai-factory-supervision
description: Local React supervision UI and Node backend for AI Factory

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix automation && npm run build --workspace @ai-factory/contracts && npm run build --workspace ai-factory-server && npm run build --workspace ai-factory-ui
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test server/dist/tests/approvals.test.js server/dist/tests/backlog-sync.test.js server/dist/tests/config.test.js server/dist/tests/contracts.test.js server/dist/tests/editing.test.js server/dist/tests/github.test.js server/dist/tests/persistence.test.js server/dist/tests/runs.test.js server/dist/tests/stories.test.js server/dist/tests/sync.test.js
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node --test server/dist/tests/doctor.test.js server/dist/tests/execution.test.js server/dist/tests/http.test.js server/dist/tests/projects.test.js
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start --workspace ai-factory-server
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace ai-factory-server
